full_judgment: 2. On 21-02-82 the said predecessor-in-interest of the present petitioners as plaintiff instituted the suit for recovery of possession of the suit land purportedly under Section-95 read with Section-95A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. The suit land is a tank with surrounding banks measuring 0.03 acre of Plot No. 8430 and 0.23 of Plot No. 8431 appertaining to R S Khatian No. 1585 of Mouja Durgapur, PS Mirsharai in the District of Chittagong.
